items.source: Use basePackageClasses() for a type-safe alternative to String-based package names.
items.translation: 使用basePackageClasses()作为基于字符串的包名的类型安全替代方案。

items.source:
Consider creating a special no-op marker class or interface in each package that
serves no purpose other than being referenced by this attribute.
items.translation: 在每个包中创建一个特殊的无操作标记类或接口，其唯一用途是被此属性引用。

items.source: Registers packages with AutoConfigurationPackages. When no base packages or base package classes are specified, the package of the annotated class is registered.
items.translation: 注册包，使用 AutoConfigurationPackages。当未指定任何 基础包 或 基础包类 时，注册的是被注解类的包。

items.source: Type-safe alternative to basePackages() for specifying the packages to be registered with AutoConfigurationPackages.
items.translation: 用于指定要注册到AutoConfigurationPackages的包的basePackages()的类型安全替代方案。

items.source: Base packages that should be registered with AutoConfigurationPackages.
items.translation: 应使用 AutoConfigurationPackages 注册的基础包。
